nourl: Found under the surname HOSTOWSKY, not under LUWINSKI — the title spells her maiden name with a Y and the Eisenhardt records spell it with an I, so one query cannot return both.
verified: THE MARRIAGE LASTED MONTHS. Kurt married Frances Hostowsky on 29 FEBRUARY 1956, her age given as 43 in the South African civil marriage index, and sued her for restitution of conjugal rights IN THE SAME YEAR — which in South African practice is the first step of a divorce. She married Rolf Eisenhardt on 23 May 1958.
